content:
maya shah: Quick async standup — tiny roadmap sync for embed-cache v2 rollout. What I did / blockers / today:

maya shah: What I did: merged schema changes (PR #1789), ran local perf bench, updated spec doc (docs/embedding/cache.md).
maya shah: Blocker: need eviction policy decision (ttl vs size-slab) and confirmation on key hashing to avoid PII leakage.

alex r: 👍 for size-slab to keep 99p latency predictable. Can you paste the perf repro and numbers?

maya shah: Perf snippet I used: ```ab -n 500 -c 20 http://canary.embed.local/generate```
maya shah: Numbers: baseline 95p=120ms, after schema change 95p=124ms (small regress). Full logs: github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1789#issuecomment-12345

taylor: I'll take PR #1789 for review today after lunch. Quick note: security flagged raw user IDs in cache keys — we should hash keys before storage.

ji-hoon: Launch prep items: docs, migration job + prune script. Blocked on prune script approval from infra (needs runbook).

priyanka: I'll add A/B telemetry dashboards. Which metrics do we want for the rollout gate?

maya shah: Include: errors, median/95/99 latency, cost per token, cache hit ratio, and model-variant fallback rate. Also watch tail token latency.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy finished: embed-cache-canary@v2 deployed to eu-west-1 (green).

alex r: If canary looks stable by 4pm PT we can promote to dedicated pool. @ji-hoon can you estimate migration window?

ji-hoon: Estimate 20-30 minutes with live prune. Will schedule it for after 4:30pm PT to avoid peak traffic.

priyanka: :thumbsup: I'll add dashboard and an alert: cache hit < 30% OR error rate > 0.5% triggers @oncall and #incidents.

maya shah: One ask before rollout: please add label `prio/launch` on the schema PR and ping reviewers.

taylor: Done — labeled and left rollback steps in the PR description (how-to revert kv-format and rehydrate).

alex r: LGTM from product side. No blockers beyond monitoring and the prune approval.

maya shah: Great — will follow up in the PR thread and post a short post-rollout checklist here once we start the migration. Thanks everyone :)
